19 | Evoke Vision | 1 item | varies | touch | I

# Descriptions
@@ 1
Gives a general idea of the place of origin of an item.
@@ 2
Detects if a curse is upon a person, place or object.
@@ 3
Caster gets a vision of up to 1 minute (per level of experience) into the
past. The caster must select the point in the past to be viewed (and the
vision will be accurate within one minute). The vision must be associated with
a person, place or object touched at the time of casting. The vision includes
sight and sound. The vision will last up to 1 round (per level of the caster)
if the caster concentrates and remains inactive. Time passes at a rate of one
round of real time for 10 rounds of vision.
@@ 4
Gives the origins of an item’s power.
@@ 5
This spell gives the caster the ability to scan the past by “feeling the
temporal location for significant events.” This translates to the caster
knowing the approximate timeframes of significant events, without knowing the
nature of the events. If the caster casts a Vision Behind spell within one
minute of casting this spell, he will be able to see the specific events.
@@ 6
Gives a vision of a significant event in the item’s past.
@@ 7
As Vision Behind I, except time range is up to 10 minutes per level of the
caster (with an accuracy of ±5 minutes) and the trance can last up to 1 minute
per level of the caster.
@@ 8
When cast before a Vision Behind spell, this allows the caster to perceive the
past using one (and only one) additional sense (i.e., smell, taste, feel) or
to use one and only one perceptive skill (in addition to the normal vision and
hearing; such as Power Perception or Reality Awareness).
@@ 9
As Vision Behind I, except time range is up to 1 hour per level of the caster
(with an accuracy of ±30 minutes) and the trance can last up to 5 minutes per
level of the caster.
@@ 10
Gives significant details about an item’s construction and purpose (not
specific powers).
@@ 11
As Vision Behind I, except time range is up to 1 day per level of the caster
(with an accuracy of ±1 hour) and the trance can last up to 10 minutes per
level of the caster.
@@ 12
As Item Vision, except gives a vision of a significant event in the past which
occurred at the caster’s current location.
@@ 13
Caster may cast this spell while in a Vision Behind; it saves an image of a
person, location, or object that can later be used by another Vision
Behindspell (to key in on the saved image).
@@ 14
Gives an analysis of the origin of a curse, the source of its power, the
nature of the curse, and its effectiveness (i.e., level).
@@ 15
As Vision Behind I, except time range is up to 1 month per level of the caster
(with an accuracy of ±1 day) and the trance can last up to 1 hour per level of
the caster.
@@ 16
Gives a complete rundown on an item’s construction, powers and purpose
(completeness or specificity of information may be reduced if the item is
extremely powerful).
@@ 17
As Vision Behind I, except time range is up to 1 year per level of the caster
(with an accuracy of ±1 week) and the trance can last up to 5 hours per level
of the caster.
@@ 18
As Item Vision, except gives a vision of a significant event which happened in
the target’s past.
@@ 19
By using an appropriate reflecting medium (e.g., a pool, crystal ball, or
mirror), the caster may cast this spell before casting a Vision Behind spell
to cause the vision to appear in the medium. Persons other than the caster
will only receive the visual aspects of the vision. Each person other than the
caster will continue to share the vision until either they stop concentrating,
the caster stops concentrating, or the trance ends.
@@ 20
If the caster has general information concerning an event in the past of a
person, place, or object, casting this spell before a Vision Behind spell will
cause the Vision Behind spell to key in on the event most closely matching the
description. The more accurate and specific the description, the more accurate
this spell will be.
@@ 25
As Vision Behind I, except time range is up to 10 years per level of the
caster (with an accuracy of ±1 month) and the trance can last up to 10 hours
per level of the caster.
@@ 30
As Vision Behind VII, except time range is up to 100 years per level of the
caster (with an accuracy of ±1 year), and the trance can last up to 1 day per
level of the caster.
@@ 50
As Vision Behind VII, except time range is unlimited (with an accuracy of ±10
years), and the trance can last up to 1 day per level of the caster. Time
passes at a rate of 1 minute of real time for each hour of the vision.
